audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer read "Skill" on rows 0 and 3 where the content layer and packet levelChart read Orianna and Brand.
audit.why: Level 1 Orianna's 815-range Q plus passive-stacked autos beat Brand before Blaze can be applied twice; levels 4-5 are his kill window because Pillar of Flame (W, 10s) applies Blaze and Sear then stuns.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Orianna, phases[3].side -> Brand, with phases[3].why rewritten to describe him winning that stage.

audit.why: Spike sequence is sound: his 4-5 stun combo, both ults at 6, an even first-item damage race, and Orianna pulling ahead at two items on Shockwave setup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was stated only vaguely and breakdown.cooldowns carried no number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Sear (Q, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6) only stuns a target already ablaze. Blaze comes from Pillar of Flame (W, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8) or Conflagration (E, 13/12/11/10/9). Dodge the Pillar and the stun cannot exist. Pyroclasm is 100/90/80 against your 110/95/80 Shockwave, so his ult returns first.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, dos/donts bullets and report[5] rebuilt on those numbers and on the Blaze prerequisite.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; unsupported magnitude in breakdown.mid; dosFull[2].d claimed a "fifteen-second" window that matches no ability in either kit.
audit.why: Sear is 8s at rank 1, not 15s. Lint findings otherwise deterministic.
audit.corrected: All four fields rewritten to match their titles and the real timers.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his kill window: Pillar of Flame sets Blaze, then Sear stuns. Never stand in the pillar with the ball away.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It governs your forward steps. - E Command: Protect spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Sear (Q) is 8s at rank 1 and only stuns a target already ablaze, so dodging Pillar of Flame (W, 10s) deletes the stun outright. - Conflagration (E) is 13s at rank 1 and is his other Blaze source. - Pyroclasm is 100s against your 110s Shockwave: his ult returns first, so never trade ults on his clock.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball sends your jungler in shielded with a live R.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Sear is 8s and Conflagration 13s at rank 1 — once he spends both on the wave, step in with Q-W and auto-weave the passive stacks.

edits.before: Brand burns Sear (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Pyroclasm is 100s at rank 1; answer his commit with R, never his poke.

edits.before: That’s Brand’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: His combo needs Blaze on you first — without the Pillar there is no stun.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Command: Protect is a 9s shield; Shockwave is 110s. Spend the shield on Conflagration and keep the ult for his commit.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by landing Pillar of Flame first, stunning through Blaze with Sear, and burning you down before the shield.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — you pick the moment, and against Brand that means Shockwave the clump his own Pyroclasm is already bouncing through.

edits.before: Track Brand’s Sear (Stun): Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Sear (Q, 8s): it only stuns a target already ablaze. Dodge Pillar of Flame (W, 10s) and his stun combo has no opener at all; Conflagration is 13s.

notes: Cross-layer chart disagreement was only on rows 0 and 3 (full said Skill, content said Orianna and Brand). I moved the full layer onto the content values, which match packet.levelChart, so no win[N] edits were required. dosFull[2].d carried a fabricated 'fifteen-second' window — Sear is 8s at rank 1 — and is replaced. Brand is male; no pronoun defects. Ability names in the file were all correct.
